name: globeorflat-hub
description: GlobeOrFlat Open Science Hub — zero-build public SPA over the Cloudflare D1 API (Cesium 3D globe + Leaflet AEQD flat plane)
author: AndrexTheDev
comment: No build step and no runtime npm dependencies: Leaflet and Cesium load from CDNs in the browser. The commonjs type scopes node-side helper tests (app.js is a plain browser script).
